Closes #2791

## What changed and why

This branch gives each of the 10 tempo and card keywords (Charge, Rush, Equip, Tradable, Stack, Spell Damage, Lucky, Deft, Flashback, Temporary) a Beat — #2782's smallest tier — in the web's effects layer ([`apps/web/src/fx/motifs/beats.ts`](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill/_work/_temp/work/item-2791/apps/web/src/fx/motifs/beats.ts)), keyed on #2783's `via` where one exists and otherwise on the existing events plus the keywords and ids the view shows, through the shared callout cue and the stagger, callout-cap, reduced-motion and intensity rules of the combat-keyword part. New ruling [`spec/rulings/R2791000.md`](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill/_work/_temp/work/item-2791/spec/rulings/R2791000.md) pins the 10 designs with its §11 paragraph in [`spec/pending/2791.md`](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill/_work/_temp/work/item-2791/spec/pending/2791.md); three new named constants (`FX_STACK_LAND`, `FX_DEFT_FEINT_STEP`, `FX_CHARGE_LINE_SPREAD`); 10 callout icons; a vitest pin per beat in [`apps/web/src/fx/motifs/tempoBeats.test.ts`](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill/_work/_temp/work/item-2791/apps/web/src/fx/motifs/tempoBeats.test.ts) asserting R200; and rows in `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md`.

Pass 2 answers the review's blocking finding (below). No other scope was touched.

## The finding: held, and fixed

**Held.** `tradableInBeat` matched the first `traded` for the player plus any later `shuffledIn`, with no link to the trade's own draw and no first-draw gate — I reproduced it: a later unrelated `drawn` (same player, trade's own draw between) planned a spurious Tradable callout plus sparkle burst.

**Fix.** A Trade is one immediate action — the `shuffledIn` after its `traded` and the `drawn` after that (R1838001) — so the beat now answers only the trade's own first draw: scanning history back over same-player `traded`/`shuffledIn`/`drawn` events, the two most recent must be `traded` then `shuffledIn`, with no draw of theirs between. An instance link is impossible (R202: the trade's ids are hidden per zone), so this positional adjacency is the correct gate; it also matches the spec's own wording. The ruling note's keying sentence was tightened to "the trade's own shuffle immediately before it (its first draw only, R1838001)".

## How it was tested

- New regression cases in the Tradable vitest: a later unrelated draw, a next-turn draw across `turnStarted`, and a draw after a trade with no shuffle between — all plan nothing. Observed the later-draw case fail before the fix (spurious callout+sparkle) and pass after.
- `tempoBeats.test.ts`: 14/14 pass. Neighbors (`beats`, `cues`, `entrances`, `flavorEntrances`, `constants`): 189 pass. `FxLayer.test.tsx`: 42 pass.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` clean; `eslint` on both touched files clean; `cargo fmt --check` clean; `cargo jackioh spec check` ok (1652 rulings, 3951 proofs); `apps/web/src/wire` untouched.

## Decisions

- Filter the adjacency scan to the three trade event types for the same player (rather than full consecutive adjacency): other players' interleaved events and any future unrelated payloads between the triple can't break the beat, while any intervening same-player trade event (the trade's own draw, a second trade) correctly closes the gate. Rejected: linking by instance id (hidden per R202) and leaving the loose existence check (the reported bug).
- Kept the fix to `tradableInBeat` only; no finding named any other beat, so nothing else was refactored.

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 2 of 3.

Notes the reviewer left (not blocking):

- `apps/web/src/fx/motifs/beats.ts`: Stack beat keys on slot occupancy, not on the Stack keyword, so any summon onto a pile (layered summons, tokens) pulses as Stack.
- `apps/web/src/fx/motifs/beats.ts`: Deft beat fires on every same-turn attack after a switch, not just the first, since the switch stays in same-turn history.
- `apps/web/src/fx/motifs/tempoBeats.test.ts`: The opponent seat's Tradable draw (in-beat) has no explicit pin; only the out-swirl is pinned region-to-region.

This part gives the tempo and card keywords a **Beat** each, #2782's smallest tier: at most about 400 ms at speed 1, inside its entry, never holding the game. The beats key on #2783's `via` field and the existing events.

|---|---|

| **Stack** | Each copy lands on the stack with a stacked-card offset and a count pulse. |
| **Spell Damage** | A Spell's damage motif burns hotter, with a "+N" sigil on the source as the spell resolves. Keyed on the bonus the engine reports, or on the view's Spell Damage total. |

| **Deft** | A quick feint before an aimed random cast lands. |
| **Flashback** | The card rises from the graveyard pile wreathed in a ghost frame, then is exiled after it resolves. |
| **Temporary** | A fading hourglass on the card, and a dissolve when it leaves at the end of its time. |

- [ ] Each of the 10 keywords has a beat with a vitest pinning its cues for a fixture event stream, each asserting R200.
